units.summary: Freight document processing was identified as the best first proof-of-concept candidate because it has high volume, measurable baselines, a clear business case, and mixed-quality multilingual documents that current vision-language models can handle reasonably well.
units.quote: Document processing is the best first candidate: high volume, measurable baseline (clerk hours, error rate), clear ROI, and modern vision language models handle mixed-quality photos and multilingual documents reasonably well.

units.summary: The suggested initial scope is one document type, POD, at one site, Vantaa, before scaling.
units.quote: Start with one document type (POD) and one site (Vantaa) before scaling.

units.summary: Handwriting is identified as the main risk for document processing and should be tested using real samples.
units.quote: Handwriting is the main risk; must be tested on real samples.

units.summary: The proposed document extraction process would have a person check only documents with low confidence.
units.quote: automatic extraction of the fields into the TMS with a human check only for low-confidence documents

source.locator: 3.1 Freight document processing (highest priority for the company)

units.summary: The requested pilot sample is 200 anonymised freight documents across types, sites and languages, including at least 50 with handwritten remarks.
units.quote: Jari: send anonymised sample of 200 freight documents (mix of types, sites, languages, at least 50 with handwritten remarks) - by 30 October 2026.

units.summary: A data assessment is the proposed first step for forecasting to determine whether the WMS data is suitable.
units.quote: Forecasting is valuable but depends on data quality - need a data extract first.

units.topic: customer service email use case sequencing
units.summary: Email triage is proposed as a second step, after an AI usage policy is in place, because it has the most compliance work.
units.quote: Email triage is relatively easy technically but has the most compliance work; good second step once an AI policy exists.

units.topic: AI usage policy and Copilot training
units.summary: An AI usage policy and short practical training on Copilot are identified as quick wins regardless of the proof of concept.
units.quote: An AI usage policy and short Copilot training are quick wins regardless of the PoC.

units.summary: Because the IT function consists of one person, any solution should be low-maintenance or operated by a partner.
units.quote: Risk: single IT person = bottleneck. Any solution must be low-maintenance or partner-operated.

units.summary: The workshop's proposed next-state ideas include starting with PODs in Vantaa.
The meeting notes record an estimate of about 1,200 freight documents per day across all sites, subject to checking against volume data.
units.quote: Mikko estimated about 1,200 documents per day across all sites. (To be checked against the volume data Jari will send - the TMS log may give a different number.)

source.locator: 3.1 Freight document processing (highest priority for the company)

units.summary: The recording gives a TMS-log-based estimate of about 1,000 documents on a normal working day.
units.quote: I would say it's a bit less, maybe around 1,000 on a normal working day according to the TMS document log.
